comment: Cloud-lane capability matrix (HIMMEL-6135). cloud-route.mjs builds its run-time-need check from every row with a match (joined in order, flag i) and its ask cap from max_asks; a row with no match is reference for briefs and shepherds. Method and sources: the state repo research doc cloud-lane-capability-map-2026-10-17.md.

rows.capability: luna vault and other personal vaults
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): luna, vaults absent, by design

rows.capability: handover state repo ($HANDOVER_DIR, handovers/, specs/)
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): handover state absent, by design

rows.capability: qmd vector search, embed, model pull
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE; the himmel BM25 collection stays cloud
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): setup-env.sh indexes himmel BM25 only, no model pull and no embed (fits the ~5 min setup)

rows.capability: semantic graphify extraction (/graphify, --backend)
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE; graphify AST update and query stay cloud
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): graphify installed AST-only, no backend extra and no backend key

rows.capability: qmd collections other than himmel
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): setup-env.sh adds the himmel collection and nothing else

rows.capability: station state under ~/.himmel or ~/.cache
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): fresh root home, user CLAUDE.md absent, user deny rules 0

rows.capability: the LIVE eval / run ledgers on the station
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): no station state in the VM (fresh home)

rows.capability: arming the cadence, systemd timers, at/atrm jobs
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): the VM is per-session; at ships without a running atd and nothing outlives the session

rows.capability: himmel test VMs (vmsdk, VBoxManage, VM snapshots)
rows.local_split: run the ticket LOCAL-NATIVE; the console runs VM suites
rows.evidence: session_01FTpE2XHmk2hPJ71fwo5nSs (PR 1771): test-install-symmetry-vm rc=3, no VM reachable

rows.capability: briefs with several asks (cap: max_asks)
rows.local_split: more than max_asks asks: LOCAL-NATIVE
rows.evidence: PR 1925: 5 asks all mapped done under Ticket coverage; session_01YVUS69PmeBP7BDn23ZZ2n4 (PR 1765) reported the asks it could not do. No silent drop found; the cap stays as the conservative bound

rows.capability: commit and open a PR to main
rows.evidence: 189 of 193 PRs carrying a claude.ai/code session link merged (the 4 closed: none for a cloud capability), e.g. session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493)

rows.capability: push to a branch of its choice
rows.local_split: the session pushes to its claude/... branch and the classifier refuses commits outside the brief file scope; the local shepherd owns out-of-scope follow-ups
rows.evidence: session_01D8SLdstcHYxysU2d5HvEbT (PR 1760): could only push claude/leg-resume-brief-repo-flag-sp6zmm; session_01SmK2DSikFdi3x7VWdUC1Zd (PR 2168): out-of-scope commit refused

rows.capability: repo shell suites
rows.local_split: suites that need a non-root user, unshare or a VM run at the local shepherd
rows.evidence: session_01EdvHkMJjbkVH78iuz4qu4u (PR 2014): test-uninstall-provenance 62/63 as uid 0; session_012yMgxSaSskpLb4qrfXBhk1 (PR 2314): test-claude-mock-turn needs unshare -rn

rows.capability: bun and node tests
rows.local_split: a red that also fails on untouched main in the VM (uid 0, proxy, no unshare) is re-run locally
rows.evidence: session_01BCqPMDHjUE9Z52yEy3J3Uf (PR 2306): bun test 42 pass 1 fail, the same fail on untouched origin/main as uid 0; bun 1.4.2, node 22.22.0 per session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493)

rows.capability: shellcheck
rows.evidence: session_01UYU1H9JAxc4PYgcc6JPr6x (PR 2200): shellcheck rc=0 on all three touched files

rows.capability: pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push gates
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): the git-hooks step installs all three; a ticketless commit message is refused rc 1

rows.capability: gitleaks binary for the pre-push secret scan
rows.local_split: if the setup-env.sh gitleaks step reports failed, the local shepherd runs the secret scan
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): gitleaks not installed by setup (before HIMMEL-6135); setup-env.sh step 3a now installs gitleaks 8.30.1, sha256-pinned to the CI release; cse_014jSqhdQMC6HYFeB2y2vBpc (PR 3037 CLOUD-DONE probe): setup-env.sh rc 0, step=gitleaks action=install v8.30.1, gitleaks version 8.30.1

rows.capability: repo .claude/settings.json hooks
rows.local_split: a hook that needs HIMMEL_REPO over-blocks; the shepherd runs that step
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): 40 hook commands wired, 9/9 PreToolUse deny probes DENY; session_01BpfAfkxHtZhfAP3spgSXyR (PR 1761): guard-pr-check-literal refused impacted-suites.sh, HIMMEL_REPO unset

rows.capability: user-scope deny rules and user CLAUDE.md
rows.local_split: every rule a cloud session needs lives in the repo
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): deny=0, user CLAUDE.md absent

rows.capability: himmel plugins
rows.local_split: only the lean set (himmel-ops, lean-skills) via setup-env.sh --with-plugins; the claude.ai plugin upload does not load
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): plugins-installed himmel-ops@himmel,lean-skills@himmel, 2 plugin hook files (81 locally)

rows.capability: Jira (Atlassian connector or the repo CLI)
rows.local_split: the local shepherd does every Jira move and comment
rows.evidence: session_0147gtwYugQiJ5odwGAJdSba (PR 2005): connector not available; session_01DZfjtTs2skmhgvXwoJkKU9 (PR 2008): connected but not enabled; session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493): jira-token-set no

rows.capability: SendMessage to a local console
rows.local_split: the session answers with a CLOUD-DONE / CLOUD-ACK PR comment; a local shepherd relays READY
rows.evidence: session_013KTA4ZC9nxtrGz6SDZvH7q (PR 1752): replied by a top-level CLOUD-ACK PR comment, never by SendMessage

rows.capability: console sends a follow-up to a running session
rows.evidence: session_013KTA4ZC9nxtrGz6SDZvH7q (PR 1752): a claude -p --cloud follow-up got CLOUD-ACK within minutes (stopped: yes, last pushed sha)

rows.capability: stop or pause a session from the CLI
rows.local_split: send a stop follow-up and wait for CLOUD-ACK
rows.evidence: session_013KTA4ZC9nxtrGz6SDZvH7q (PR 1752): stopping needed a follow-up message; no CLI stop exists

rows.capability: gh commands that use GraphQL (gh pr list, gh pr view)
rows.local_split: use gh api REST endpoints (repos/{owner}/{repo}/...) in the cloud
rows.evidence: cse_014jSqhdQMC6HYFeB2y2vBpc (PR 3037 CLOUD-DONE probe): gh pr list rc 1, HTTP 403 GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions; gh api repos/yotamleo/Himmel/pulls rc 0

rows.capability: commands up to 10 minutes
rows.local_split: suites past 600 s run locally
rows.evidence: session_01Jo7fMAczdmtLo9JcyzwbYK (PR 1809): test-arm-resume hit the 600 s cap; the cap comes only from the env-vars dialog

rows.capability: network egress
rows.local_split: hosts outside the Trusted allowlist are reached locally
rows.evidence: session_01TpA3C48Z3WXun4uaXa9yMs (PR 2493, HIMMEL-5442 parity probe: setup-env.sh, parity-probe.sh, check-env.sh all rc 0): pypi, npm, ubuntu archive 200; example.com 000; HTTPS goes through a proxy

rows.capability: scripts that need HIMMEL_REPO (the primary-checkout anchor)
rows.local_split: those steps run at the local shepherd
rows.evidence: session_01BpfAfkxHtZhfAP3spgSXyR (PR 1761): HIMMEL_REPO unset, impacted-suites step refused
